graphChecks.notes: No new package edge. The change tightens failure behavior (production without Redis or without a completed migration now refuses to serve / degrades readiness) rather than adding a capability; the government of report-only scan branches is documentation and ownership, not code.

knownGaps: Human gate pending: the maintainer must confirm the CI blocking policy (report-only exceptions with repo-maintainer ownership and per-release review) and the production Redis requirement — the implementation deliberately tightened both by default.

The os.Exit(1) startup path for a missing PANTHEON_REDIS_ADDR cannot be exercised in a unit test (logging.Fatal terminates the process); it is covered by the RequireRedis unit tests plus code-path review.
npm audit is not recorded here: it is a release-time runbook check rather than a per-change gate.

Historical (closed 2026-09-23): go test -race was initially unavailable locally (only the Cygwin gcc was installed, which Go refuses for native Windows cgo). It now passes with a project-local MinGW-w64 toolchain in the gitignored .tmp/mingw64 — see the race entry above.
